title: Amazon S3 to Amazon SNS
description: Sends notifications from S3 to SNS when an object is created.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This SAM template creates an S3 bucket and an SNS topic. S3 writes a messages to the SNS topic when a new object is put into the bucket.

bullets.text: Building resilient serverless patterns by combining messaging services
Choosing between messaging services for serverless applications

testing.headline: Testing
text: 1. Go to the SNS Console and select the topic that was created after running sam deploy.
3. Under Protocol, select the type of endpoint to subscribe to (email, SMS, etc.)
5. Upload an object to the S3 bucket you created.
